ℹ️ Our Story
About Nepal Public Secondary Boarding School
🏆 A+ Grade
🎓 NEB Affiliated
📋 EMIS Registered

Nepal Public Secondary English Boarding School was founded in 2060 B.S. as a Center of Excellence in Samsi-5, Mahottari, Madhesh Province. Since then the school has grown into a leader in progressive education and a pioneer in improving instruction quality across Nepal — from Nursery through Grade 12 (+2).

📍 Location

Samsi-5, Pokharivinda, Mahottari, Madhesh Province, Nepal

🎓 Programs

Nursery – Grade 12 (+2) | Science | Management | Humanities

🏫 Affiliation

NEB Affiliated | EMIS Registered | Govt. Recognized | PABSON Member

📞 Contact

+977 9801671781 | info@nepalpublic.edu.np

"At Nepal Public, we believe education is a joyful discipline. Since 2060 B.S., our promise has been simple: every child known, challenged, and cared for. Our +2 program builds strong foundations while nurturing 21st-century skills — critical thinking, communication, creativity and character."

— Mr. Bineet Jha
Founder & Principal | Director: Anu Jha | PABSON Member

📋 Requirements
